title: P.U.(A) 64/2024: general service tax 6% to 8% on 1 March 2024
summary: The Service Tax (Rate of Tax) (Amendment) Order 2024 raises the general service-tax rate from 6% to 8% from 1 March 2024. Food and beverage, telecommunication, parking, and logistics remain at 6% and are recorded as a reduced First Schedule treatment from the same date.

legal_basis.title: Perintah Cukai Perkhidmatan (Kadar Cukai) (Pindaan) 2024
legal_basis.instrument: P.U. (A) 64/2024, amending Service Tax (Rate of Tax) Order 2018 [P.U. (A) 213/2018]
legal_basis.pinpoint: para 1(2) in force 1 Mac 2024; F&B, telecommunication, parking, logistics stay at enam peratus; others lapan peratus

legal_basis.title: MySST | Background
legal_basis.instrument: RMCD MySST webpage, Tax Rate section

changes.summary: General service tax moves from 6% to 8%.

migration_impact.summary: Invoices for taxable services other than F&B, telecommunication, parking, and logistics use 8% from 1 March 2024. Services through 29 February 2024 stay at 6%.

changes.summary: Food and beverage, telecommunication, parking, and logistics remain at 6% and are encoded as a distinct reduced treatment from this date.

migration_impact.summary: Billing systems must keep a 6% path for the four retained groups and must not automatically lift them to 8%.

after.description: Retained 6% band for F&B, telecommunication, parking, and logistics.
